sourceText:
Potato Chowder
By: Kitch-N-Chik
Published: Saturday, February 13, 2010 - 4:54am

Ingredients




1 medium onion chopped
1 cup chopped celery
1 tablespoon butter or margarine
1 can Spam luncheon meat - (7 oz) diced
1 can condensed chicken broth - (10 ¾ oz)
1 cup water
1 pound potatoes - (abt 3 med) peeled, diced
1 teaspoon caraway seeds
Freshly-ground black pepper to taste
1 cup half-and-half
1 cup chopped fresh parsley

Preparation

1 In medium saucepan, saute onion and celery in butter until tender. Add Spam; cook 3 minutes, stirring often. Add chicken broth, water, potatoes, caraway, and pepper. Cover and cook until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. Stir in half-and-half and parsley; heat and serve.
